quests.title: The Slowest Postcards
quests.summary: Fetch a sack of postcards from Rothera, get it signed by a biologist and a glaciologist, and bring it back to the Penguin Post Office.

steps.text: Collect the mail sack from the hangar at Rothera.
Show a Clearfin to the marine biologist at the Bonner Laboratory.
Beat the glaciologist on the Brunt Ice Shelf, then see the scientist in Halley VI.
Take the sack back to the Penguin Post Office at Port Lockroy.

quests.reward: A Clearfin and two Midwinter Dinners.

quests.title: The Emperor Census
quests.summary: Catch a Downlet and show it to the penguin counter on the Brunt Ice Shelf.

steps.text: Catch a Downlet and show the counter.
